android.desc: BoxStream Cloud Music is a simple music player for Dropbox. Stream your music, podcasts, and audiobooks directly from Dropbox. BoxStream keeps your library organized the way you already have it: by folders. No required library import, no long metadata scan, and no separate music service account. Browse your Dropbox folders, play tracks instantly, favorite the songs you want quick access to, and control playback from your phone, Android TV, Chromecast, Bluetooth headset, car stereo, or media remote. Features: ★ Stream music, podcasts, and audiobooks from Dropbox ★ Browse your existing Dropbox folder structure ★ Gapless playback ★ Favorites playlist ★ Shuffle and repeat modes ★ Album art and ID3 metadata support ★ Headset, Bluetooth, and car media controls ★ Chromecast support ★ Android TV support BoxStream is designed for people who already keep their audio collection in Dropbox and want a fast, familiar way to play it anywhere. Unlike apps that first need to scan and synchronize your whole library, BoxStream opens your folders directly so you can start listening right away. Your files stay in your Dropbox account. BoxStream simply helps you browse, stream, and control playback across your devices.
